description:
Brand Introduction

ABS Filaments is a trusted name in the 3D printing industry, offering premium-quality 3D printing filaments, resins. Partnering with some of the world’s best 3D printing brands, we ensure that creators, manufacturers, and hobbyists have access to the most advanced and reliable materials for their innovative projects. With a focus on quality, affordability, and sustainability, ABS Filaments has become a go-to choice for 3D printing enthusiasts across the globe.

Product Description

Our product lineup includes:

  • 3D Printing Filaments: High-performance ABS, PLA, PETG, TPU, PCL, PC ,PEEK, NYLON, CLEANING, ASA, TPR, HIPS, TPE filaments, available in a wide range of colors and sizes, ensuring consistent and smooth 3D printing results.
  • 3D Printing Resins: Ultra-precise resins ideal for prototyping, artistic modeling, and industrial applications, compatible with leading 3D printers. Our Catagory includes Standard Resins, Castable Resins, Special Resins, Water Washable Resins.
  • Top Brands: We collaborate with world-renowned brands such as Anycubic, Creality, Flashforge, Magforms, Esun, Create Bot, Geeetech, Snapmaker, Sunlu, 3idea, XYZ Printing, Zortrax etc ensuring our customers access the latest and most advanced technologies.
  • Accessories: Enhance your 3D printing experience with our range of accessories, including nozzles, filament dryers, and adhesives.

Unique Selling Points (USP)

  • Access to Global Leaders: We bring you products from the world’s best 3D printing brands, ensuring you always have cutting-edge technology at your fingertips.
  • Unmatched Quality: All our products are rigorously tested to guarantee superior performance.
  • Wide Compatibility: Our filaments, resins, and accessories are compatible with most major 3D printer models.
  • Affordable Pricing: Premium-quality products at competitive prices, making innovation accessible to all.
  • Sustainable Practices: We prioritize environmentally friendly materials and packaging to reduce our carbon footprint.
  • Exceptional Customer Service: A dedicated team to support you at every step of your 3D printing journey.
  • Fast Shipping Across India: Reliable delivery services to ensure you receive your products quickly.

Payment Terms

  • Commission Rate: Earn a competitive commission of 10% on every successful sale referred through your unique link.
  • Payment Methods: Affiliates can receive payments via UPI, bank transfer, or PayPal.
  • Refund/Chargeback Policy: Commissions for refunded or canceled orders will be adjusted in the following payout cycle.

Other Information

  • Affiliate Dashboard: A user-friendly platform to track clicks, conversions, and earnings in real time.
  • Training & Resources: Comprehensive guides and expert tips to help affiliates optimize their campaigns.
  • Cookie Duration: A [30-day] tracking cookie ensures you earn commissions even if the customer purchases later.
  • Exclusive Opportunities: Affiliates will be the first to access promotions and offers on the world’s best 3D printing brands, enhancing their earning potential.

This version highlights the global partnerships and positions ABS Filaments as a premium destination for high-quality 3D printing supplies. Let me know if you'd like further adjustments!
